sections.title: Habitats
lines: Underground

sections.title: Appearance
lines: A Large, round-bodied beetle with a domed carapace, six legs and paired antennae.

sections.title: Senses
lines: Keensense 10 ft.

sections.title: Attacks
lines: Bite · melee · +5 to hit · reach 5 ft. · 1d6 + 3 piercing

sections.title: Trait mechanics
lines: Knockdown Charge · Move at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature. The beetle can force it to make a DC 12 STR save or fall prone. If the target is prone, the beetle can Bite it once as a bonus action.

sections.title: Reaction mechanics
lines: Poison Spit · When the beetle takes damage, it can spit a 15-ft. line. Creatures in the line make a DC 12 DEX save. Failure deals 1d6 poison damage and leaves the creature poisoned for 1 minute. Success halves damage and prevents the condition. The creature can end the condition with a DC 12 CON save at the end of each of its turns.

sections.title: Mount mechanics
lines: Mount cost and load · 200 gp. Carrying capacity 480 lb.
Climbing and burrowing · A rider has to pass a WIS (Animal Handling) check to stay on a climbing or burrowing mount. The DC starts at 10 and increases by 1 for every 5 ft. the mount moves that way.
Secure Saddle · Fastening this saddle takes two rounds. It grants advantage on checks and saves to stay mounted.

sections.title: Table notes
lines: Black Flag fixed values are Perception 10 and Stealth 11. Ability modifiers are STR +3, DEX +1, CON +2, INT −5, WIS +0 and CHA −4. No languages.
The book calls it Round Beetle, Giant and prints CR 1/4. This profile uses the printed fraction for the existing Beetle, Giant Round entry, whose index value is 0.3.
Source: Kobold Press, Campaign Builder: Dungeons & Ruins (2025), pp. 28–29.

sections.title: Trait mechanics
lines: Water Aversion · The worm refuses to enter bodies of water. If water fills its burrow while it is digging, it must Dash away from the water on its next turn.

sections.title: Action mechanics
lines: Thrash (Recharge 4–6) · Every creature within 5 ft. makes a DC 13 DEX save. Failure deals 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage and success halves it. A creature that fails by 5 or more also falls prone.

sections.title: Reaction mechanics
lines: Reflexive Writhe · If the worm can see a creature attacking it, it can raise its AC to 14 against that attack.

sections.title: Mount mechanics

Secure Saddle · Fastening this saddle takes two rounds. It grants advantage on checks and saves to stay mounted.

sections.title: Table notes

otherVersions.description: A giant fire beetle is a nocturnal creature that takes its name from a pair of glowing glands that give off light. Miners and adventurers prize these creatures, for a giant fire beetle’s glands continue to shed light for 1d6 days after the beetle dies. Giant fire beetles are most commonly found underground and in dark forests.
